extracted.name: Chicken, Broccoli, and Cottage Cheese Casserole
extracted.description: A favorite at family gatherings, this easy chicken and broccoli casserole is rich and filling with a buttery crumb topping.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10 ounce) cans white meat chicken, drained and flaked
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
0.25 cup creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine broccoli and 1/2 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat. Cover and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain.
Transfer broccoli to a 9x13-inch casserole dish. Add chicken, condensed soup, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese, salad dressing, and lemon juice and mix until well combined.
Mix crushed crackers and melted butter together; sprinkle over the casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 30 minutes.
